I found three likely Marrow Fieldworks ticket numbers and sent you the list in our DM. I'm assuming they're all Marrow Fieldworks, but neither source names the account next to the ticket numbers.

- **#4409**, from Moss's digest "Central handoffs next week" (2 Jan 2026): a timeout that keeps coming back on the Gatehouse Check-In report at the Salina North yard. Hollis flagged it as open before the 5 Jan handoff.
- **#4412**, from the same digest: a minor glitch in the text prompt drivers get when staging combine trailers on unpaved overflow lots. Hollis flagged it at the same time.
- **#8841**, from your own message in #central-random on 13 Oct at 09:27: West yard Door 2 at the Plains depots is double-booking when flatbeds check in early.

**Why I think they're Marrow Fieldworks:** the digest calls it "Pree's dealer account" and says Marrow Fieldworks changes hands on 5 Jan. Hollis's message in #central-random calls it "Tobias's dealer account." Worth confirming before the call.

**Left out:** FR-882 belongs to Marrow Agrisupply, a different account, and it's a feature request rather than a ticket. Moss's other notes don't mention any Marrow Fieldworks tickets.

**Status:** I couldn't see whether any of these are open or closed. #4409 and #4412 date from January, so they may have been resolved since.

I only used sources you can see yourself: #central-random (you're a member) and Moss's public notes.
